info.title: Robis API
info.description: Generated from the route contracts in shared/contracts/src/http. A refused request answers { error, message }.

get.summary: The workspaces you are a member of, oldest first.

post.summary: Make a workspace, with you as its owner and a #general channel.

get.summary: One workspace you are a member of.

patch.summary: Rename a workspace or change its theme.

delete.summary: Delete a workspace and everything in it, confirmed with your password.

get.summary: The last 100 things that happened in a workspace, newest first.
A workspace's projects, oldest first, each with its count of open issues.

post.summary: Make a project; its key is derived from the name unless given.

get.summary: One project.

patch.summary: Rename a project, change its description, or archive it.

delete.summary: Delete a project and its issues.

get.summary: A workspace's members, in the order they joined.

post.summary: Invite someone by username (201, the invitation) or by address (202, sent whether or not it has an account).

patch.summary: Change a member's role, within your own authority.

delete.summary: Remove a member, within your own authority.
Leave a workspace; the last owner cannot.

get.summary: Invitations from a workspace that have not been answered.

delete.summary: Withdraw an invitation that has not been answered.

get.summary: The invitations waiting for you, from any workspace.

post.summary: Join the workspace an invitation is for.
Turn an invitation down.

get.summary: Issues that may be duplicates of a draft; empty when the service has nothing.
A suggested priority for a draft, a refusal with the counts it needs, or null for nothing to say.
A page of a project's issues, newest first, with a cursor for the next.

post.summary: File an issue; it takes the next number in its project.

get.summary: One issue.

patch.summary: Change an issue: its title, description, status, priority or assignee.

delete.summary: Delete an issue, its comments and its images.

get.summary: An issue's comments, oldest first.

post.summary: Comment on an issue; anyone it @mentions is told.

delete.summary: Delete your own comment, or as an admin, anyone's.

get.summary: A workspace's documents, most recently changed first.

post.summary: Start a document, in the workspace or under one of its projects.

get.summary: One document, with its text as it stands.

delete.summary: Delete a document and its history.

get.summary: A workspace's channels, by name.

post.summary: Open a channel; its name is normalised, and must be free.

patch.summary: Rename a channel or change its topic.

delete.summary: Delete a channel and its messages.

get.summary: A page of a channel's messages, newest first, with a cursor for the next.

post.summary: Post a message to a channel.

delete.summary: Delete your own message, or as an admin, anyone's.

get.summary: Upcoming meetings, soonest first (and those that ended in the last half hour), or past and called-off ones, latest first.

post.summary: Schedule a meeting; the organiser is an attendee who has said yes.

patch.summary: Change a meeting you organise, or call it off.

post.summary: Say whether you are coming.

get.summary: Your last 100 notifications, newest first, with how many are unread.

post.summary: Mark one notification read.
Mark every notification read.

get.summary: A page of a workspace's audit trail: newest first, or from a sequence number onwards for an export.
Everyone who appears in the trail, members first, former members after.

post.summary: Check the chain, from the last signed checkpoint, or from the start with full=1; names the first bad link.

get.summary: Issues, documents and comments matching a query, best first.
The home in one read: every workspace you are in, and the open issues assigned to you.

post.summary: Add an image to an issue, or to one of its comments; it is re-encoded and stripped of metadata, within the workspace's storage limit.

get.summary: An issue's images, its comments' included.

delete.summary: Remove an image you added, or as an admin, any.

post.summary: Make an account from a sign-up link, and sign in.
Sign in; the session is a cookie.
Sign out of this browser.

get.summary: Your own account.

patch.summary: Change your name or username; an old username is held for 90 days.

delete.summary: Delete your account, with your password and a decision for every workspace you alone own (409 lists the undecided).

get.summary: Whether a username can be had, and if not, why.

post.summary: Change your password; every other session ends.

get.summary: Where you are signed in.

post.summary: Start signing up: a link goes to the address, and the answer is the same whether or not it has an account.
Ask for a reset link. Always 202, whatever was sent, so the answer never says whether an address has an account.
Set a new password from a reset link; every session ends.
Confirm your address from the link that was mailed to it.
Mail the confirmation link again, unless the address is confirmed already.
Agree to the current terms.
Keep the username an account was given, once asked.

get.summary: A page of your own account's trail: sign-ins, password and username changes.

post.summary: Check your account trail's chain; names the first bad link.

put.summary: Use a photo as your picture; it is re-encoded small and stripped of metadata.
Use a generated picture, drawn by the web app from its seed.
